exec sys.sp_set_session_context @key = N'email', @value = N'owner@example.com'

SELECT SESSION_CONTEXT(N'email') AS v, CAST(SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(SESSION_CONTEXT(N'email'), 'BaseType') AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS base_type, CAST(SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(SESSION_CONTEXT(N'email'), 'MaxLength') AS INT) AS max_length
SELECT CAST(SESSION_CONTEXT(N'email') AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS email
SELECT SESSION_CONTEXT(N'EMAIL') AS upper_key, SESSION_CONTEXT(N'Email') AS title_key, SESSION_CONTEXT(N'email ') AS trailing_space, SESSION_CONTEXT(N'missing') AS missing
SELECT SESSION_CONTEXT(@k) AS v
EXEC sp_set_session_context N'tenant', 42

SELECT SESSION_CONTEXT(N'tenant') AS v, CAST(SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(SESSION_CONTEXT(N'tenant'), 'BaseType') AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS base_type, CAST(SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(SESSION_CONTEXT(N'tenant'), 'MaxLength') AS INT) AS max_length, CAST(SESSION_CONTEXT(N'tenant') AS INT) AS tenant
DECLARE @v BIGINT = 9000000000; EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key = N'big', @value = @v; SELECT SESSION_CONTEXT(N'big') AS v
exec sys.sp_set_session_context @key = N'param', @value = @v

SELECT SESSION_CONTEXT(N'param') AS v, CAST(SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(SESSION_CONTEXT(N'param'), 'BaseType') AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS base_type, CAST(SQL_VARIANT_PROPERTY(SESSION_CONTEXT(N'param'), 'MaxLength') AS INT) AS max_length

EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context N'', 1
EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context N'only'

BEGIN TRAN; EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context N'tx', 5; ROLLBACK; SELECT SESSION_CONTEXT(N'tx') AS v, @@TRANCOUNT AS tc

BEGIN TRY EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context NULL, 1 END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT ERROR_NUMBER() AS n, ERROR_PROCEDURE() AS p END CATCH
